author: Newfresh13
quote: Low quality cashgrab slop made for mindless sub 40 iq cattle. Over a decade and a billion dollars budget during development and released as an insanely buggy game is pathetic. The gameplay is gta 5s with rdr2s unfun “realism” sprinkled over everything, forcing you to do boring, menial tasks that you have to do in real life, like painting your house, filling your gas tank, and buying groceries. Also you cant even commit gta whenever you want to, even though the game is called gta. Gta 6 has incredibly bland writing and characters as well, none of them i really cares abt at all. The game is also riddled with “anti furry” and “wojak” humor from 2019. Of course, rockstar glazers cant see any of these problems and realize that they got scammed out of $100. 0/10.
